literature_notes: DCBLD1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein (signal peptide 1–34 cleaved; extracellular 35–458; TM 459–479; intracellular 480–715). Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe C-terminal MYC/FLAG or FLAG tags appended after residue 715, which lies on the intracellular face. Neither line reports any tag insertion on the extracellular domain (residues 35–458) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 34). No ledger line supports an extracellular surface tag for DCBLD1; zero sites qualify. The C-terminal tag positions are captured in other_positions as intracellular.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal MYC- and FLAG-tagged full-length DCBLD1 construct; residue 715 is the last intracellular residue (topology 480–715 = intracellular), so the appended tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
C-terminal Flag-tagged full-length DCBLD1 used in functional/interaction studies; same intracellular C-terminus as L1 — not an extracellular surface tag.
